judgment.note: A class after `class` on the line of `class` is a `style-word` unit, an `Identifier` token, but the check takes an `Identifier` or a `RawText` token for every class of a class statement, without telling a class on that line from one after a line feed, which is an `unquoted-text` unit and a `RawText` token. In requirement/db-class-statement (`class r,e a,b`), changing the token of the class `a` at [61,62] to `RawText` is not reported. The other cases are reported: an unquoted name as an `Identifier` token (check-tree-requirement.test.ts, "the name of a requirement as an Identifier token"); a name that holds whitespace split into two tokens, or its token widened over the spaces before it; a name after `class` as a `RawText` token (check-tree-shared-tokens.test.ts); and a name after `style` or `classDef` as a `RawText` token (check-tree-requirement.test.ts).
